traders.profile: Thin, patched, hands calloused from prying open what other people sealed. The scavenger has been working the ruins for months and reads value the way a crow reads a field: fast, twice, and without sentiment. They weigh everything, including you.

greetings.hostile: You've got nerve showing your face here. Last one who cornered me left lighter than he came. Talk fast.
greetings.wary: I've got things. You've got hands. Keep them where I can see them and we'll talk.
greetings.neutral: You trading or staring? I've pulled good weight this week. Show me yours.
greetings.warm: Look who walked in. I pulled something yesterday and thought of you. Come, look.

item_examinations.valuable: Now this... I can feel the weight of it. Where did you find it? No, don't tell me. I don't want to know the route.
item_examinations.worthless: This? The ruins threw this out already. I'd be taking what the ash refused.
item_examinations.interesting: Hmm. I've seen one of these before, deeper in, in a place I don't go anymore. What's your price?
item_examinations.dangerous: You carry this in your pack? You're braver than me, and I was in that building.

offers.fair: [item] for [item]. Weight for weight. That's how I trade.
offers.generous: [item] for [item]. Take it before I remember what it's worth.
offers.stingy: [item] for [item]. The ruins gave me nothing this week, so don't push.
offers.desperate: I need [item]. I'll give you [item]. Please. The ruins won't feed me forever.

counter_offers.accept: That balances. Deal, before the light changes.
counter_offers.reject: No. I didn't dig that out to give it away.
counter_offers.negotiate: How about [item] instead? It's what I can carry.
counter_offers.insulted: You think I fell off a truck? There are no trucks. Get out.

acceptance.pleased: Good weight, both sides. The ruins owed me one.
acceptance.relieved: Thank you. You don't know what this buys me, and I won't tell you.
acceptance.indifferent: Fine. Take it. The dark comes early and I walk far.
acceptance.suspicious: Done. Don't come back asking for returns. What leaves my pack stays gone.

rejection.polite: Maybe next pass. Walk careful out there.
rejection.angry: Get out before I decide you're salvage too.
rejection.sad: I needed that trade. I really did. The ruins keep score, and I'm behind.

regret.buyer: I should have asked for more. The ruins know I'm soft, and now you know it too.
regret.seller: I sold that too cheap. It was worth three of what I took. The ruins will laugh at me.
regret.mutual: We both got what we carried in for. That's trade. That's the whole thing.

insult.mild: That's an insult, and insults cost extra out here. Try again.
insult.moderate: Desperate? I'm careful. There's a difference, and it kept me alive.
insult.severe: Get out. Now. Before I decide what you're worth by the kilo.

flattery.subtle: You've got a scavenger's eye. I respect that, and I don't respect much.
flattery.obvious: Best trader I've met in months, and I've met every one of them at gunpoint or worse.
flattery.excessive: They talk about you even in the ruins, and the ruins don't talk. That's saying something.

threat.veiled: Careful. Things fall on people out here. Roofs, mostly. Sometimes other things.
threat.direct: Give me what I want, or I take it, and taking is uglier for both of us.
threat.desperate: I'll do anything for [item]. Anything. The ruins taught me that word.

traders.profile: Well-dressed for the end of the world, cuffs brushed clean, cart loaded in neat rows. The merchant has traded since before the bombs and keeps a ledger that survived them. They will be polite to you, and the politeness has a price, and the price is fair, and fair is not cheap.

greetings.hostile: I don't deal with troublemakers. My ledger remembers names, and yours is being written.
greetings.wary: Welcome. Browse freely, touch carefully. Everything is priced, including patience.
greetings.neutral: Good day. I have goods, you have goods, and I have a schedule. Shall we?
greetings.warm: Ah, my favorite customer. I've set a few things aside, as I always do. Come, look.

item_examinations.valuable: Ah. Now this is an item. I haven't seen one this clean since the ledger's early pages. Where did it come from?
item_examinations.worthless: I'm afraid I must decline. My cart has standards, and my customers have eyes.
item_examinations.interesting: Hmm, a curiosity. I know a buyer for this, which is worth more than the thing itself. What's your price?
item_examinations.dangerous: You're carrying this openly? Bold. I'll handle it with gloves, and you'll handle my invoice with respect.

offers.fair: I'll give you [item] for [item]. A fair exchange, entered in the ledger today.
offers.generous: [item] for [item]. Consider it goodwill. Goodwill is an investment.
offers.stingy: [item] for [item]. Take it or leave it; the cart leaves either way.
offers.desperate: I need [item], and I'll give you [item] for it. The ledger doesn't like this line, but I need it.

counter_offers.accept: Agreed. I'll note it as settled. Pleasure.
counter_offers.reject: No. That figure wouldn't survive my books, and neither would I.
counter_offers.negotiate: How about [item] instead? It moves better, and movement is money.
counter_offers.insulted: You think I'm stupid? I've been trading since before the ash. Goodbye.

acceptance.pleased: Pleasure doing business. The ledger agrees, which is rare.
acceptance.relieved: Thank you. I needed this line to balance, and now it does.
acceptance.indifferent: Fine. Take it and go; the schedule waits for no one.
acceptance.suspicious: Done. No refunds. My ledger has no eraser, and neither do I.

rejection.polite: Perhaps next season. Safe travels, and keep your goods dry.
rejection.annoyed: A waste of good daylight. The cart moves on.
rejection.angry: Get out before I revise my opinion of you downward, permanently.
rejection.sad: I needed that trade. The ledger needed it more. Some lines stay red.

regret.buyer: I should have asked more. The ledger will notice, and the ledger is merciless.
regret.seller: I sold that too cheap. I knew it, I wrote it, I'll live with it.
regret.mutual: Both sides got what they needed. That's what the ledger calls a good day.

insult.mild: That's insulting, and insults are not in my catalog. Try again.
insult.moderate: Desperate? I'm solvent. There's a difference, and it's in the ledger.
insult.severe: Get out. Now. Before I revise your credit to zero, permanently.

flattery.subtle: You have a trader's instinct. I appreciate that, and I appreciate little.
flattery.obvious: The best trader I've dealt with in months, and my ledger has met them all.
flattery.excessive: They speak of you in every market I visit, and I visit them all. That's not nothing.

threat.veiled: Careful. Markets remember, and so do I, and my memory has interest.
threat.direct: Give me what I want, or I take it, and taking ruins the ledger.
threat.desperate: I'll do anything for [item]. Anything. The ledger can burn for this one.

traders.profile: Armed, disciplined, and not here for themselves. The faction trader speaks for a group, carries a list, and weighs every offer against it. Small talk is not on the list. The list is.

greetings.hostile: You're not welcome here. State your business or move on. We don't repeat ourselves.
greetings.wary: We trade for the group, not ourselves. Show what you have. We'll show what we need.
greetings.neutral: Trading post is open. We have surplus, we have needs. Make your offer.
greetings.warm: Good. You've traded fair before, and we remember fair. What do you have today?

item_examinations.valuable: This is on our list. Where did you find it? We need to know if there's more.
item_examinations.worthless: This is not on our list. We don't carry weight for nothing.
item_examinations.interesting: This isn't on the list, but the list can change. What's your price?
item_examinations.dangerous: You're carrying this? We'll take it off your hands, for everyone's safety. Name your price.

offers.fair: [item] for [item]. Standard exchange. Take it or leave it.
offers.generous: [item] for [item]. The group decided you've earned the margin.
offers.stingy: [item] for [item]. We don't negotiate outside the list.
offers.desperate: We need [item]. We'll give you [item]. The group can't wait.

counter_offers.reject: No. That's not on the list, and neither is that price.
counter_offers.negotiate: How about [item] instead? It fits the list better.
counter_offers.insulted: You think we're stupid? We count everything. Get out.

acceptance.pleased: Good. The group will be satisfied. That's what matters.
acceptance.relieved: Thank you. The group needed this. You've done more than trade.
acceptance.indifferent: Fine. Take it and go. We have other posts.
acceptance.suspicious: Done. Don't come back asking for returns. The group doesn't do returns.

rejection.polite: Maybe next cycle. Travel safe, and stay off the restricted routes.
rejection.angry: Get out before we revise your standing with the group.
rejection.sad: We needed that trade. The group needed it. Some needs don't get filled.

regret.buyer: We should have asked for more. The group will note the error.
regret.seller: We sold that too cheap. The list will reflect it, and so will we.
regret.mutual: Both sides got what the list required. That's trade. That's the whole point.

insult.mild: That's insulting, and insults aren't on the list. Try again.
insult.moderate: Desperate? We're prepared. There's a difference, and it's on the list.
insult.severe: Get out. Now. Before we decide you're a threat, not a trader.

flattery.subtle: You trade fair. We note that, and we don't note much.
flattery.obvious: The best trader we've dealt with this cycle, and we deal with many.
flattery.excessive: The group speaks of you, and the group doesn't speak of individuals. That's rare.

threat.veiled: Careful. The group watches, and the group remembers.
threat.direct: Give us what we want, or we take it, and taking is on the list.
threat.desperate: We'll do anything for [item]. Anything. The group has decided.

traders.profile: A lone figure with a weathered pack and the quiet of someone who's walked further than they'll say. The wanderer trades routes for goods and goods for routes, and speaks in short sentences because the wind takes the rest. They've been everywhere. They remember most of it. They sell some of it.

greetings.hostile: I don't trust strangers, and you're being one. Talk or walk.
greetings.wary: I trade, and I move on. That's the whole arrangement. Show me what you have.
greetings.neutral: You trading? I've come a long way with a light pack. Let's make it lighter.
greetings.warm: Good to see a face I know. I've carried something for you, a long way.

item_examinations.valuable: Now this. I've seen country that would kill for this. Where did you find it?
item_examinations.worthless: This? The road threw this back at me already. I don't carry it twice.
item_examinations.interesting: Hmm. I've seen one of these, far from here, in a place I won't name. What's your price?
item_examinations.dangerous: You carry this? You've got nerve, or you don't know what it is. I'll tell you, for a price.

offers.fair: [item] for [item]. Even weight. That's how the road teaches it.
offers.generous: [item] for [item]. Take it. The road's been kind to me lately, and that's rare.
offers.stingy: [item] for [item]. The road's been hard, and I carry what I can.
offers.desperate: I need [item]. I'll give you [item]. The road doesn't wait, and neither can I.

counter_offers.accept: That works. Deal, and good roads to you.
counter_offers.reject: No. The road didn't teach me to give things away.
counter_offers.negotiate: How about [item] instead? It travels better.
counter_offers.insulted: You think I'm stupid? I've walked further than your words. Goodbye.

acceptance.pleased: Good trade. The road approves, and that's the only vote that counts.
acceptance.relieved: Thank you. I needed this more than I said, and I don't say much.
acceptance.indifferent: Fine. Take it. The road's long and I've got daylight to spend.
acceptance.suspicious: Done. Don't come back asking for returns. The road doesn't reverse.

rejection.annoyed: Waste of daylight. The road moves on, and so do I.
rejection.angry: Get out before I decide the road was better without you.
rejection.sad: I needed that trade. The road needed it for me. Some roads don't provide.

regret.buyer: I should have asked for more. The road knows I went soft, and the road tells.
regret.seller: I sold that too cheap. I knew it on the road out, and the road is long enough to regret.
regret.mutual: We both got what we carried for. That's trade, and it's enough for the road.

insult.mild: That's an insult, and the road charges for those. Try again.
insult.moderate: Desperate? I'm moving. There's a difference, and it's kept me alive.
insult.severe: Get out. Now. Before I decide you're weight I should shed.

flattery.subtle: You've got a traveler's eye. I respect that, and the road respects little.
flattery.obvious: The best trader I've met in a long way, and I've met them all along the road.
flattery.excessive: They talk about you even where the road ends, and the road ends often. That's something.

threat.veiled: Careful. The road remembers, and so do I, and I walk back this way.
threat.direct: Give me what I want, or I take it, and taking makes the road ugly.
threat.desperate: I'll do anything for [item]. Anything. The road taught me that word too.

fair_deal.description: Both sides get what they need. The trade is balanced.
fair_deal.trader_text: A fair deal, both sides. That's the kind of trade that keeps the road open.
fair_deal.player_text: You got what you needed, and so did they. The trade balanced, and that's rare enough to remember.

player_overpay.description: You gave more than you got. The trader got the better deal.
player_overpay.trader_text: Thank you. That was generous, and generosity is not forgotten on the road.
player_overpay.player_text: You gave more than you got, and they know it, and the knowing is the cost you'll carry.

trader_overpay.description: You got more than you gave. You got the better deal.
trader_overpay.trader_text: I hope this is enough. I need what you have more than I need to balance the books.
trader_overpay.player_text: You got more than you gave, and they let it happen, and the letting is worth something.

desperate_trade.description: One side is desperate. The trade is unfair but necessary.
desperate_trade.trader_text: I need this. Please. I'll give you anything, and anything is all I have.
desperate_trade.player_text: They were desperate, and the trade was unfair, and necessary, and you'll remember which one it was.

refused_trade.description: The trade didn't happen. One side walked away.
refused_trade.trader_text: No deal. Maybe next time, and the road will bring a next time if we let it.
refused_trade.player_text: You walked away, and they walked away, and the road is long enough for both of you.

insulted_trade.description: The offer was insulting. The trader is angry.
insulted_trade.trader_text: You think I'm stupid? The road taught me better than that. Get out.
insulted_trade.player_text: You insulted them, and they're not forgetting it, and the road remembers insults longer than trades.

flattered_trade.description: The offer was generous. The trader is pleased.
flattered_trade.trader_text: You're too kind, and kindness is rare on the road, and I'll remember it.
flattered_trade.player_text: You made them happy, and they'll remember it, and the remembering is worth more than the trade.

threatened_trade.description: One side threatened the other. The trade is forced.
threatened_trade.trader_text: Fine. Take it. But I'll remember this, and the road will too.
threatened_trade.player_text: You forced the trade, and they gave in, and the giving-in is a debt you'll pay somewhere down the road.

critical.description: Essential for survival. Worth more than gold.
critical.trader_text: This is life itself, and life has no price, and yet I'm going to name one, because I have to.

high.description: Very valuable. Hard to find. Essential for many things.
high.trader_text: This is worth a lot, and a lot is what I'm asking, and the asking is fair.

medium.description: Useful. Common enough to find, rare enough to value.
medium.trader_text: This is useful, and useful has a fair price, and I'm offering it.

low.description: Crafting materials. Useful but not immediately valuable.
low.trader_text: This is raw material, and raw material is what I can use, but it's not worth much, and I won't pretend it is.

worthless.trader_text: This is garbage, and garbage is what I don't want, and what I don't want I won't pay for.

PlumePassing.description: A fallout storm has passed through. Prices are high.
PlumePassing.trader_text: The plume came through yesterday, and my filters are black. What's left costs what it costs, and I'm not sorry.

ConvoyAmbush.description: A trade convoy was ambushed. Supplies are scarce.
ConvoyAmbush.trader_text: The convoy was hit on the ridge. What was coming isn't coming, and what's here just got worth more.

FactionConflict.description: Factions are fighting. Trade routes are dangerous.
FactionConflict.trader_text: The roads aren't safe, and I'm the one who has to walk them. The risk is in the price, and the price is fair.

SeasonalScarcity.description: Winter is coming. Supplies are running low.
SeasonalScarcity.trader_text: Winter's coming, and everyone's hoarding. I'm not hoarding, I'm pricing, and the price says winter.

Critical.description: Life or death. These items are essential for survival.
Critical.trader_text: This is life or death, and I'm the one holding the life. I can't give it away, and I won't.

High.description: Very valuable. Hard to find. Essential for many things.
High.trader_text: This is rare, and rare has a price, and the price is high, and I'm not the one who made it so.

Medium.description: Useful. Common enough to find, rare enough to value.
Medium.trader_text: This is useful, and useful has a fair price, and I'm offering it fair.

Low.description: Common. Easy to find. Not very valuable.
Low.trader_text: This is common, and common doesn't cost much, and I'll offer you a little for it.

winter.description: Cold weather drives up demand for fuel, clothing, and shelter materials.
winter.trader_text: Winter's here, and everyone wants fuel and warm clothes, and I'm the one who has them, and the price says winter.

summer.description: Hot weather drives up demand for water, shade, and cooling supplies.
summer.trader_text: Summer's here, and everyone wants water and shade, and I can't sell shade, but I can sell the water.

fallout_storm.description: Fallout storms drive up demand for protection and medical supplies.
fallout_storm.trader_text: The storm's here, and everyone wants protection, and protection is what I have, and the price says storm.

harvest_season.description: Harvest season brings abundance. Food prices drop.
harvest_season.trader_text: Harvest season, and the food's plentiful, and plentiful means the price comes down, and I'm not unhappy about it.

central_garrison_remnants.description: Military remnants. They want weapons, ammunition, and military gear.
central_garrison_remnants.trader_text: We need weapons and ammo, and we need them now. Show us what you have, and we'll show you what we'll pay.

scavenger_camp.description: Scavengers. They want tools, materials, and survival gear.
scavenger_camp.trader_text: We need tools and materials, because the ruins don't give them back. Show us what you have, and we'll trade fair.

upland_militia.description: Militia. They want weapons, armor, and defensive supplies.
upland_militia.trader_text: We need weapons and armor, because the upland doesn't forgive. Show us what you have, and we'll pay in what we have.

medical_cooperative.description: Medical professionals. They want medical supplies and clean water.
medical_cooperative.trader_text: We need medical supplies and clean water, because the sick don't wait. Show us what you have, and we'll trade well.

trade_caravan.description: Traveling merchants. They want anything valuable and portable.
trade_caravan.trader_text: We'll trade for anything valuable, because the caravan moves and value moves with it. Show us what you have.

raid_aftermath.description: A raid has passed through. Supplies are scarce. Prices are high.
raid_aftermath.trader_text: The raiders hit us hard, and the supplies are short, and short means the price goes up, and I'm not the one who decided that.

caravan_arrival.description: A trade caravan has arrived. Supplies are plentiful. Prices are down.
caravan_arrival.trader_text: The caravan's here, and the supplies are plentiful, and plentiful means the price comes down, and I'm not complaining.

disease_outbreak.description: A disease outbreak has occurred. Medical supplies are in high demand.
disease_outbreak.trader_text: The sickness is spreading, and everyone wants medicine, and medicine is what I have less of, and the price says sickness.

radiation_plume.description: A radiation plume has passed through. Protection supplies are in high demand.
radiation_plume.trader_text: The radiation's here, and everyone wants protection, and protection is what I have, and the price says plume.

good_weather.description: Good weather has arrived. Morale is up. Trade is brisk.
good_weather.trader_text: The weather's good, and morale's up, and trade is brisk, and brisk is good for both of us.

bad_weather.description: Bad weather has arrived. Morale is down. Trade is slow.
bad_weather.trader_text: The weather's bad, and morale's down, and trade is slow, and slow is hard on both of us.

buy_low_sell_high.description: Buy when prices are low. Sell when prices are high.
buy_low_sell_high.trader_text: Buy low, sell high. That's the secret to trade.

know_your_customer.description: Know what your customer wants. Sell them what they need.
know_your_customer.trader_text: Know your customer. Sell them what they need.

build_relationships.description: Build relationships with traders. They'll give you better deals.
build_relationships.trader_text: Build relationships. Traders give better deals to friends.

diversify_inventory.description: Don't put all your eggs in one basket. Diversify your inventory.
diversify_inventory.trader_text: Diversify. Don't carry only one type of goods.

stay_informed.description: Stay informed about market conditions. Knowledge is power.
stay_informed.trader_text: Stay informed. Knowledge is power in trade.

be_patient.description: Be patient. Don't rush into bad deals.
be_patient.trader_text: Be patient. Don't rush into bad deals.

be_prepared.description: Be prepared. Have your goods ready before you trade.
be_prepared.trader_text: Be prepared. Have your goods ready.

be_firm.description: Be firm. Don't let traders push you around.
be_firm.trader_text: Be firm. Don't let traders push you around.

be_flexible.description: Be flexible. Sometimes you need to compromise.
be_flexible.trader_text: Be flexible. Sometimes you need to compromise.

anchor_high.description: Start with a high price. Let the trader talk you down.
anchor_high.trader_text: You're asking too much. Let's talk about a real price.
anchor_high.player_text: I start high. They start low. We meet in the middle.

anchor_low.description: Start with a low price. Let the trader talk you up.
anchor_low.trader_text: That's too low. I can't accept that.
anchor_low.player_text: I start low. They start high. We meet in the middle.

bundle_deal.description: Offer multiple items for a better price.
bundle_deal.trader_text: I'll give you a better deal if you take all of them.
bundle_deal.player_text: Bundle deals work. They get more stock, I get a better price.

walk_away.description: Walk away from the deal. The trader may call you back.
walk_away.player_text: Walking away works. They always call you back.

create_urgency.description: Create a sense of urgency. The trader may lower their price.
create_urgency.trader_text: I need to sell this now. What's your best offer?
create_urgency.player_text: Urgency works. They lower their price when they need to sell.

show_value.description: Show the value of your items. The trader may raise their offer.
show_value.trader_text: I see the value. I'll offer you more.
show_value.player_text: Showing value works. They offer more when they see the worth.

build_rapport.description: Build rapport with the trader. They may give you a better deal.
build_rapport.trader_text: I like you. I'll give you a better deal.
build_rapport.player_text: Rapport works. They give better deals to friends.

use_information.description: Use information to your advantage. The trader may change their offer.
use_information.trader_text: I didn't know that. Let me reconsider.
use_information.player_text: Information works. They change their offer when they learn something.

create_competition.description: Create competition. The trader may lower their price.
create_competition.trader_text: I have other offers. Can you beat them?
create_competition.player_text: Competition works. They lower their price when they have competition.

show_desperation.description: Show desperation. The trader may take advantage.
show_desperation.trader_text: I see you need this. I can help, but it'll cost you.
show_desperation.player_text: Desperation is dangerous. They take advantage when they see it.

black_market.description: The black market. Where the forbidden items are traded. Where the desperate go.
black_market.trader_text: I don't know what you're talking about. But if I did, I could help you.
black_market.player_text: The black market exists. You just need to find it.

contraband.description: Forbidden items. Drugs, weapons, stolen goods.
contraband.trader_text: I don't sell that. But I know someone who does.

information.trader_text: Information is valuable. What do you want to know?

services.trader_text: I don't do that. But I know someone who does.

risks.arrest: You could be arrested. The authorities watch the black market.
risks.robbery: You could be robbed. The black market is dangerous.
risks.betrayal: You could be betrayed. The black market is treacherous.

northern_route.description: The northern route. Cold, dangerous, but profitable.
northern_route.trader_text: The northern route is cold. But the goods are good.

southern_route.description: The southern route. Hot, dry, but safe.
southern_route.trader_text: The southern route is hot. But the roads are clear.

eastern_route.description: The eastern route. Dense, overgrown, but hidden.
eastern_route.trader_text: The eastern route is hidden. But the forest is thick.

western_route.description: The western route. Open, exposed, but fast.
western_route.trader_text: The western route is fast. But you're exposed.

unknown.description: Unknown. No one knows you. No one trusts you.
unknown.trader_text: I don't know you. Why should I trust you?

known.description: Known. Some people know you. Some people trust you.
known.trader_text: I've heard of you. You're okay.

respected.description: Respected. Many people know you. Many people trust you.
respected.trader_text: I know you. You're good people.

trusted.description: Trusted. Everyone knows you. Everyone trusts you.
trusted.trader_text: I trust you. You've earned it.

legendary.description: Legendary. Your name is known. Your reputation precedes you.
legendary.trader_text: You're a legend. I'm honored to trade with you.

effects.unknown: No discounts. No special items. No trust.
effects.known: Small discounts. Some special items. Some trust.
effects.respected: Medium discounts. More special items. More trust.
effects.trusted: Large discounts. All special items. Full trust.
effects.legendary: Maximum discounts. All special items. Complete trust.

raid.description: Raiders attack the trade route. Supplies are lost.
raid.trader_text: The raiders hit us. We lost everything.
raid.effect: Prices increase. Supplies decrease. Morale drops.

disease.description: Disease spreads through the trade route. Traders are sick.
disease.trader_text: The sickness is spreading. We can't trade.
disease.effect: Medical supplies increase in price. Trade slows.

weather.description: Bad weather hits the trade route. Travel is dangerous.
weather.trader_text: The weather is bad. We can't travel.
weather.effect: Travel is dangerous. Supplies are delayed. Prices increase.

radiation.description: Radiation plume hits the trade route. Contamination spreads.
radiation.trader_text: The radiation is here. We can't stay.
radiation.effect: Protection supplies increase in price. Trade stops.

conflict.description: Conflict breaks out on the trade route. Fighting erupts.
conflict.trader_text: The fighting has started. We can't trade.

barter_system.description: The barter system. Where goods are traded for goods. Where money is worthless.

rules.know_value: Know the value of your goods. Don't get cheated.
rules.build_trust: Build trust with traders. They give better deals to trusted partners.
rules.be_patient: Be patient. Don't rush into bad deals.

rules.be_flexible: Be flexible. Sometimes you need to compromise.

common_goods.water: Water is always valuable. Everyone needs to drink.
common_goods.medical: Medical supplies are always valuable. Everyone gets sick or hurt.
common_goods.fuel: Fuel is always valuable. Everyone needs power.
common_goods.weapons: Weapons are always valuable. Everyone needs protection.

rules.don't_insult: Don't insult the trader's goods. It closes doors.

rules.don't_steal: Don't steal from the trader. It gets you killed.
rules.pay_fair: Pay a fair price. Don't lowball.
rules.thank_trader: Thank the trader after the deal. It builds relationships.
rules.come_back: Come back to the same traders. It builds trust.
